faces.transcription: Take 2 Action tokens and distribute them among the players as you like.
faces.flavor: You discovered the manufacturing facility within PEARL Compound. Stacks of empty supply crates imply that the Soviets have already manufactured a large quantity of the plague. You render the sensitive equipment inoperable with a few subtle "adjustments" that should take months to locate and repair.
